name: TRIFOLIUM PRATENSE
key_symptoms: Confusion and headache on awaking. Dullness in anterior brain. Mental failure, loss of memory.

Coryza like that which precedes hay-fever; thin mucus, with much irritation. Hoarse and choking; chills with cough at night. Cough on coming into the open air. Hay-fever. Spasmodic cough; whooping cough, paroxysms; worse at night.
Tingling in palms. Hands and feet cold. Tibial ulcers.
Neck stiff; cramp in sterno-cleido muscles; relieved by heat and irritation.
